mainEntity.name: How do I ensure my custom fire pit is safe for my family and property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ensuring the safety of your custom fire pit involves several key considerations. First, proper placement is crucial; it must be a safe distance from combustible structures, overhanging trees, and fences, adhering to local setback requirements. The construction should use appropriate, heat-resistant materials and be built to code. For gas fire pits, professional installation of gas lines and burners by certified technicians is paramount to prevent leaks. Always use a protective screen or cover while the fire is active to contain sparks. Educate all users on safe operation, never leave a fire unattended, and have a water source or extinguisher nearby.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ensure safety by proper placement away from combustibles, professional construction with heat-resistant materials, certified gas line installation, spark screens, and never leaving a fire unattended.
